propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) lacks concrete specification of the backend interface needed to decompose Phase 2 implementation stories

The backend interface must pin: rebar's local ticket as canonical model (no separate CanonicalTicket), core owns diff/apply while adapters only read/enact, role Protocols unified behind Backend facade, and RemoteRef type replacing hardcoded 'jira' literal

The reconciler backend interface must consist of five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) plus three optional capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental)
RemoteRef {vendor, instance, remote_id} should replace hardcoded vendor literals and bare remote_id usage in apply_inbound_records.py and throughout the seam
